question: Should this PR require Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept the source-only timing risk?
rationale: The patch is plausible and focused, but it changes session-state timing for a user-visible channel failure and the external PR has no direct after-fix real behavior proof.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output, production-runner logs, or equivalent terminal evidence showing the real tool result is persisted without the synthetic missing-result error.

options.title: Accept source-only risk
options.body: Maintainers can merge based on source and focused test evidence, while explicitly owning that the reported Feishu path was not proven here.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 has direct proof or a successor fix path.
